simple.meaning: קַדְמָה (qadmâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “priority (in time); also used adverbially ( before ).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

definitions.short: priority (in time); also used adverbially ( before )
definitions.full: H6927. qadmah [ קַדְמָה ] noun feminine antiquity, former state ; — 1 antiquity, beginning , suffix קַדְמָתָהּ Isa 23:7 (of Tyre). 2 former state , suffix קַדְמָתָן Ezek 16:55 (twice in verse), קַדְמַתְכֶן 16:55 ; plural suffix קַדְמוֺתֵיכֶם 36:11 . 3 construct singular = conjunction before (temporal; Aramaic) שָׁלַף שֶׁקַּדְמַת Psa 129:6 . [ קַדְמָה ] noun feminine former time (compare Biblical Hebrew קַדְמָה , Zinjirli קדמה (Cooke 177 ), former state ); — construct Dan 6:11 דְּנָה מִןקַּֿדְמַת = before this, formerly ; so Ezra 5:11 דְּ ׳מִקַּדְמַת . compare Gen 28:19 ᵑ7 J , Ezek 38:17 ᵑ7 .

occurrences.englishText: Let them be as the grass on the housetops,
Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her far away to travel?

Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former estate; and you and your daughters will return to your former estate.

I will multiply man and animal on you. They will increase and be fruitful. I will cause you to be inhabited as you were before, and you will do better than at your beginnings. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.
